description: This file defines API routes for messaging and conversation management in a FastAPI application, interfacing with a MongoDB database. It includes route handlers for sending messages, retrieving messages by conversation ID, creating conversations, and fetching conversations by user ID.

methods.name: message_helper
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB message document to a Message model, stringifying the '_id' field

methods.name: conversation_helper
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB conversation document to a Conversation model, stringifying the '_id' field

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: API endpoint to send a message, inserting it into the database and returning the created message

methods.name: get_messages
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all messages for a specific conversation ID

methods.name: create_conversation
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new conversation and store it in the database

methods.name: get_conversations
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all conversations for a specific user ID
